title: Route repair to its owner
when: At a claim registration/widening/boundary refusal or an irreducible overlap requiring escalation.
need: Read both specs and overlap evidence. Dash work holders attest independent edits during survey/isolation; ordered edits wait for proven landing. A survey contact alone is advisory. A widen classifies only the paths it adds and its refusal names each new path with the claim it overlaps; drop or order those paths. Amend mistaken selection through the registered posture surface; release live coverage first.
surface: Claim conflict procedure; Dash survey/isolation; posture amendment help; operator override
gap: Internal guide labels override human-only and includes old direct-client recipes; current override implementation describes a covering live steering seat. Review question: which current authority governs, and which public/private producers must be reconciled before promoting this guide?
review: Source and regression evidence cover Dash recovery, selection amendment and new-path-only widen refusal; deployed recipe proof is still pending.
